observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== opendata.wuerzburg.de reachable (guide: sensor data source) ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 "https://opendata.wuerzburg.de"; echo "=== config show-garden exists ==="; ls config/ | grep garden; echo "=== final process summary ==="; printf "server:8000=%s  vite:5173=%s  queue=%s  pail=%s\n" "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8000/)" "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5173/resources/js/app.ts)" "$(pgrep -f 'queue:listen' >/dev/null && echo up || echo down)" "$(pgrep -f 'pail' >/dev/null && echo up || echo down)"
